logic.note: Runs the real compiled firmware in Renode (an open-source emulator, MIT) in a local Docker container, in lockstep with Jumper's clock. GPIO (with pin interrupts), Serial, Wire and SPI reach Jumper's parts through Jumper's bridge (every signal time-stamped to the instruction). Serial is USB CDC (TinyUSB) on the real board, which is not emulated: Jumper's simulator build prints Serial on Serial1 (UARTE0, D6 / D7). Nordic's MBR and S140 SoftDevice 7.3.0 run from the core's own image; the UF2 bootloader does not.

timing.note: Virtual time counts one instruction per core clock cycle at the board's clock (no pipeline, wait-state or cache timing), so delay(), millis() and timers are exact in virtual time and busy loops are close. A part's reaction to a pin edge lands at the next simulation step (1 ms by default), not mid-step.

analog.note: Pins are ideal sources (standard drive, a few hundred Ω) with 13 kΩ pull-ups; inputs switch at 0.3 / 0.7 x 3.3 V. analogRead goes through Jumper's SAADC model: the solved voltage on the AIN pin, with the gain, reference and resolution the core sets; no noise, offset or acquisition time.

power.note: USB (power.usb) is 5 V on the 5V pin; the LDO makes 3.3 V. A LiPo on BAT+ charges at 50 / 100 mA (CC) to 4.2 V (CV) and powers the board through an ideal power path when USB is unplugged (the 5V pin then shows the battery voltage, which a real board does not). Charger efficiency, temperature and sleep currents are not simulated.

radio.note: Bluetooth LE is not emulated. Renode 1.17 has an nRF52840 RADIO model, but Jumper does not connect it to anything: advertising, scanning and connections do nothing (BLE.begin() / Bluefruit.begin() may fail or hang). Test radio code on the real board.

emulates: nRF52840 Cortex-M4F and the peripherals Arduino sketches use, in Renode 1.17 (jumper/renode image)
Digital I/O with pull-ups and pin interrupts (attachInterrupt)
Wire (TWIM0) to the I2C parts on the board's default pins
SPI (SPIM2) to the SPI parts on the board's default pins
analogWrite / Servo / tone through Jumper's PWM0..3 model (period and duty drawn as exact edges)
The BQ25101 LiPo charger: CC at 50 mA (100 mA with P0.13 LOW) then CV at 4.2 V, ~CHG on P0.17, the charge LED; the battery runs the board without USB
VBAT on P0.31 through the 1M / 510k divider while P0.14 is LOW
doesNotEmulate: Bluetooth LE and the 2.4 GHz radio
USB (the real board's USB CDC Serial, mass storage, HID)
QSPI flash, the file system on it
Low-power modes (System OFF) and their current
Wire1 / SPI1 and buses on other pins
Bus electrical detail (clock stretching, rise times)
The UF2 bootloader and double-tap reset
The XIAO nRF52840 Sense's IMU and microphone
The charger's thermal regulation, safety timers and termination detail
Speed: FreeRTOS's idle loop spins in the emulator (WFE runs as a no-op), so idle-heavy sketches run slower than real time
testOnRealDevice: USB Serial: the real board prints Serial over USB, the simulator build on Serial1
Analog readings: offset, noise, acquisition time
